text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's done it! Biwa Hayahide has won
the Kikuka
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Ha! Haha... Hehehe!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Beyond a shadow of a doubt, I finally
did it...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I won!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: Huff... Pant...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wheeze... Huff...

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text: That was pretty fun, right, Taishin?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What the heck is "fun" about
losing?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
I might've lost this time, but I'm gonna
win next
time, for sure! Raaaaah! Here I
cooome!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Haha, where's she running off to now?
She's
ridiculous.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: But... I get it. I feel the same way.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm back!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I sure did!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Wait, was that Hayahide yelling just now?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Taishin! Nice race today! Thanks
for always
bringing out the best in me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
You've got to be joking. Are you really

Hayahide? Did you and Ticket switch
bodies or
something?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: No! It's really me!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, okay.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Is it seriously her?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Ahem! Sorry about that. I guess the
adrenaline
hasn't worn off yet.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
It's whatever. I've already forgotten all
about it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, have you decided on your next
race yet?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good question. Well, since we finished
all the
Classic Triple Crown races, the
next one available
after winter is...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Exactly. It's a prestigious race in Kyoto,
and I
really want to compete with elite
racers there.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'll have to win it if I want to be called
the best of
my generation.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Good luck with that. I'll be there too.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: What?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I plan on winning, just so you know.
Later.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Well, I suppose that makes sense. I know
I only
just caught up to Taishin and
Ticket...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But I plan on winning it too. I'll win every
race I
must to reach the very top!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's an utter relief seeing how much
brighter her
smile is than before.
